question: What is the IDENTITY of a partially completed governed act — is a cohort that advanced 26 of 32 records one act with disclosed exclusions, or a different act from the one authorised?
context: Raised by cohort authorization and batched extraction. The platform already commits to a cohort hash over the sorted id set, so the SET is the identity — but that answers "what was authorised", not "is a resumed batch the same act". CI-2026-08-03-BOUNDED-PROCESSOR-PARTIAL-COMPLETION-001 captures the disclosure rule; the identity question is upstream of it.
wouldRequire: A ruling on whether resuming an interrupted batch continues the original authorization or requires a new one.
A position on receipt lineage when a batch is resumed — one receipt amended, or two receipts linked.
Evidence from a real resumed batch; the question is currently theoretical.
